flows.title: Create an event
steps: Go to luma.com/create, or click Create Event from your home page.
Enter a clear, descriptive title for your event. This will be the main headline that guests see when browsing events.
Select the date and time for your event and choose the appropriate timezone. For multi-day events, set both start and end dates.
Choose the type of event you're hosting: In-Person for a physical gathering at a specific location, Online for a virtual event, or Hybrid for both.

For an In-Person event, enter the venue name or address, which will appear on a map on your event page. For an Online event, add your meeting link, and Luma will create unique join links for each guest to track attendance.
Write a description covering what the event is about, who should attend, and what guests can expect.
Choose a cover image from Luma's curated gallery or upload your own, and pick one of the themes from categories like Minimal, Confetti, Emoji, Pattern and Seasonal.
Every event belongs to a calendar. Use your personal calendar, which is the default, select an existing team calendar you manage, or create a new calendar.

Choose who can see and register: Public events are shown on your calendar and can be indexed by search engines, Private events are unlisted so only people with the link can register, and Member-Only events are shown to active members of your calendar membership.
Click Create Event. Your event is created instantly and you are taken to the event management page.
